title: Fix WaylandThread crashing when attention is called to a destroyed window
body:

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #124493 

## Additional information
The issue was caused by a lack of concurrency guards. Since the the attention mechanism was not fully implemented before godot never ran into the issue where attention was being called to a window that is also being destroyed. Specifically ``WaylandThread::window_destroy`` did not know if there are other reference that are potentially in use (in waiting callbacks in this case). And for ``WaylandThread::_xdg_activation_token_on_done``  there was no way to check if the window pointer was still valid.

This PR adds some locks and late deletion to ``WaylandThread::WindowState`` to prevent the use-after-free from happening. Note this touches quite a few places around WaylandThread as I had to move ``WindowState`` to it's own allocations to allow it to contain the required locks. There are probably more race-conditions in wayland thread but this PR fixes the specific regression.
